commit_message:
Fix size check bypass for case-mismatched columns

The size enforcement logic in applySimpleFieldMaxSize previously relied
on exact string matching. This CL adds case-insensitive key resolution
to ensure that inputs like "DaTa1" are correctly truncated to the
maximum allowed size, preventing oversized data from bypassing checks

Bug: 414389102
Flag: EXEMPT CVE_FIX
Test: atest ContactsProviderTests
